title: Normal runtime provisioning executes release-selected mutable upstream source
title_de: Normale Runtime-Provisionierung führt release-ausgewählten veränderlichen Upstream-Source aus
protocol: GitHub latest-release selection and build provenance
trust_boundary: configured external GitHub release selection to trusted CI or operator build execution
sink: staged Git checkout followed by Expat shell/autotools build or Go package build
summary: The ordinary non-strict component provisioner accepts the mutable tag returned by GitHub releases/latest, records an expected-latest difference only as metadata, and then builds the selected source on a trusted runner.
summary_de: Der gewöhnliche nicht-strikte Komponenten-Producer akzeptiert den veränderlichen Tag aus GitHub releases/latest, zeichnet eine Differenz zum erwarteten Latest nur als Metadaten auf und baut danach den ausgewählten Source auf einem vertrauenswürdigen Runner.
observed_behavior: At Parent master 8e8acb8dab1cd03723de269cab7da7dd62e5e010, prepare_release_git_component passes the runtime latest-release tag directly to prepare_git_component even with strict=True. A mismatch with expected_prompt_latest sets release_tag_deviation but does not block. A present source record then reaches the real Go build sink; the retained harmless local fixture compiled an executable under the original implementation.
observed_behavior_de: Auf Parent-master 8e8acb8dab1cd03723de269cab7da7dd62e5e010 übergibt prepare_release_git_component den zur Laufzeit ermittelten Latest-Release-Tag selbst bei strict=True direkt an prepare_git_component. Eine Differenz zu expected_prompt_latest setzt release_tag_deviation, blockiert aber nicht. Ein present-Source-Record erreicht danach den realen Go-Build-Sink; die zurückgehaltene harmlose lokale Fixture kompilierte unter der ursprünglichen Implementierung ein Executable.
expected_behavior: Every release-resolved source that can reach a trusted build sink must be bound to an explicit reviewed immutable provenance contract before checkout and build; a changed latest release must fail closed rather than be merely reported.
expected_behavior_de: Jeder release-ausgewählte Source, der einen vertrauenswürdigen Build-Sink erreichen kann, muss vor Checkout und Build an einen expliziten überprüften unveränderlichen Provenance-Vertrag gebunden sein; ein geändertes Latest-Release muss fehlgeschlossen scheitern statt nur protokolliert zu werden.
impact: A compromised configured upstream release state can select source-controlled build behavior for a scheduled or trusted-manual runner. Repository evidence establishes runner, cache, network, and read-only contents-token exposure, but not production or release secrets, writable repository authority, or fleet deployment impact.
impact_de: Ein kompromittierter konfigurierter Upstream-Release-Zustand kann Source-kontrolliertes Build-Verhalten für einen geplanten oder vertrauenswürdig manuell gestarteten Runner auswählen. Repository-Evidence belegt Runner-, Cache-, Netzwerk- und Read-only-Contents-Token-Exposition, aber keine Production- oder Release-Secrets, keine schreibbare Repository-Autorität und keinen Fleet-Deployment-Impact.
preconditions: An attacker compromises a configured upstream GitHub release maintainer or mutable releases/latest state.
A scheduled or trusted-manual workflow or local operator invokes make prepare-runtime-components.
The selected component source reaches the normal non-strict release-backed path.
reproduction: Run the retained offline fixture validation_artifacts/validate_mutable_release_execution.py against Parent master 8e8acb8dab1cd03723de269cab7da7dd62e5e010.

Observe that a synthetic changed tag is passed to prepare_git_component with strict=True, is accepted as present, and that an intentionally harmless local Git-backed Go source reaches prepare_go_tool and produces an executable.
Review protocol-contract.yml, all-connectors-no-crs.yml, and open-connectors-smoke.yml to confirm scheduled or manual provisioner reachability and contents: read permissions.

evidence.command: rtk proxy env PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 .venv/bin/python -B validation_artifacts/validate_mutable_release_execution.py --repo-root /root/git/ModSecurity-conector --artifact-root validation_artifacts
evidence.result: A synthetic changed latest-release tag was accepted and passed to the Git-preparer with strict=True; an accepted source record reached the real Go build sink and produced an executable harmless fixture binary without network contact or upstream-source execution.

evidence.command: Repository-evidence attack-path analysis of release selection, workflow triggers, workflow permissions, source checkout, and build sinks
evidence.result: The validated path is in scope under the repository CI supply-chain threat model. Read-only workflow permissions, disabled persisted checkout credentials, no observed pull_request_target trigger, no observed secret reference, and the upstream-compromise precondition calibrate the final severity to low / P3.

root_cause: prepare_release_git_component was intentionally designed for compatibility tracking of current GitHub releases. It reuses latest-release selection for Expat outside strict evidence runs and for go-ftw/albedo, while expected latest is an observation rather than an admission control.
root_cause_de: prepare_release_git_component wurde absichtlich zur Kompatibilitätsverfolgung aktueller GitHub-Releases entworfen. Es verwendet Latest-Release-Auswahl für Expat außerhalb strikter Evidence-Läufe und für go-ftw/albedo erneut, während expected latest eine Beobachtung statt einer Admission-Control ist.
proposed_remediation: Select and document one immutable provenance contract for every release-resolved component: reviewed full Git commit, verified signed tag, or immutable source archive digest. Parent admission must reject an unexpected latest tag before checkout/build, and any Framework-owned default configuration must be changed only through a separately authorized Framework PR.
proposed_remediation_de: Einen unveränderlichen Provenance-Vertrag für jede release-ausgewählte Komponente auswählen und dokumentieren: überprüfter vollständiger Git-Commit, verifizierter signierter Tag oder unveränderlicher Source-Archive-Digest. Die Parent-Admission muss einen unerwarteten Latest-Tag vor Checkout/Build ablehnen; jede Framework-eigene Default-Konfiguration darf nur über einen getrennt autorisierten Framework-PR geändert werden.
acceptance_criteria: The selected immutable provenance contract is explicit for Expat non-strict compatibility, go-ftw, and albedo.
A release-tag deviation is rejected before checkout or source build rather than recorded as advisory metadata only.
The normal supported provisioning path preserves its existing safe cache, URL allowlist, clean checkout, submodule, and fsck controls.
Focused regression tests cover a rejected changed latest release and a legitimate approved immutable source path.
A fresh exact-head hosted workflow proof confirms the selected contract without a scanner, gate, permission, or provenance-control weakening.
validation_plan: Choose the approved immutable source identity contract and identify whether the owned defaults reside in Parent or Framework.
Add focused release-selection and build-admission tests using an offline fixture.
Run the narrow Python provisioning tests and legitimate normal-path control.
Run security-diff review and applicable workflow validation, then obtain exact-head hosted proof and a fresh SonarQube Cloud readback before verification.
regression_tests: offline release-selection and harmless local build-sink fixture
legitimate_control_tests: A configured reviewed immutable source is admitted and records the exact checked-out identity.
A changed GitHub latest-release response is rejected before checkout and build.
A normal cache/provisioning run retains safe-root, URL, submodule, and git-fsck controls.
dependencies: Current user selection of the accepted immutable provenance contract
Separate Framework write authorization if the selected default pins are Framework-owned
Exact-head hosted workflow and SonarQube Cloud evidence
blocked_by: The user has not selected whether normal release tracking must use reviewed commits, verified signed tags, or source archive digests.
Framework configuration write scope is not selected for the current task.
residual_risk: Until the normal release-resolved components have an approved immutable provenance contract, a compromised upstream release-selection state can make its source build behavior run in scheduled or trusted-manual provisioning. Current repository evidence limits the demonstrated workflow token to contents:read and does not establish secret or deployment compromise; no risk is accepted.
residual_risk_de: Bis die normalen release-ausgewählten Komponenten einen genehmigten unveränderlichen Provenance-Vertrag haben, kann ein kompromittierter Upstream-Release-Auswahlzustand sein Source-Build-Verhalten in geplanter oder vertrauenswürdig manueller Provisionierung ausführen lassen. Aktuelle Repository-Evidence begrenzt das belegte Workflow-Token auf contents:read und belegt keinen Secret- oder Deployment-Kompromiss; es wird kein Risiko akzeptiert.

history.detail: The retained no-network fixture proved that a changed latest-release tag is admitted as present and reaches the real Go build sink through the production module; no upstream source was executed.

The repository CI supply-chain threat model makes the validated provenance path in scope. Read-only workflow scope, disabled persisted credentials, no observed pull_request_target or secret reference, and the upstream-compromise precondition produce a low/P3 reportable disposition.
